02410 Chatiyta' {khat-ee-taw'}

字根已不使用,似乎意為"掘出"; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Hatita 2; 2

哈底大 = "探索"
1) 跟隨所羅巴伯被擄歸回的利未支派一個領袖,司守門
record.edic_text:
02410 Chatiyta' {khat-ee-taw'}

from an unused root apparently meaning to dig out;; n pr m

AV - Hatita 2; 2

Hatita = "exploring"
1) head of a family of Levitical porters or gate-keepers who returned
   from exile with Zerubbabel
